title: Compare European property masks in headgear inventory
changes: Add an optional positive property-mask usage assertion to the recorded-scene differential harness.
validation: An isolated Windows build and one Wine raw-versus-e100 comparison passed all 560 retained frames, matching complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio outputs while serving 91 typed mask reads.
limitations: Counts are aggregate and both arms share a native cache; broader scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
